notes: The API is free and reachable without a login. I ran METHODS: plus OPEN_ACCESS:y with FIRST_PDATE ranges and read hitCount. I only had time for two windows, not monthly bins. Counts are open-access papers whose Methods mention the term, for Jan 2025–Sep 2026 (hitCount, 12 Oct 2026). 'NovaSeq X' 4,886 (656 in H1'25, 4,230 for Jul'25–Sep'26). AVITI/AVITI24 410 (54; 356). UG100/UG 100/UG 200 17 (4; 13). AXELIOS or 'sequencing by expansion' 8 (4; 4). Rival-to-X ratio, with all three rivals summed: H1'25 62/656 = 9.5%. Jul'25–Sep'26 373/4,230 = 8.8%. Full period 435/4,886 = 8.9%. AVITI alone is 8.2% of X in H1'25 and 8.4% after, so it is flat. Monthly rate: X ~109/mo in H1'25 vs ~282/mo after (2.6x). AVITI ~9/mo vs ~24/mo (2.6x). The rival share of academic Methods mentions has not risen. That is mild evidence against the thesis's claim that academic users are shifting to rivals. Caveats: papers lag experiments by 6–18 months, so 2026 hardware adoption (VITARI, AXELIOS placements) is not yet visible. Text-mined mentions of 'AVITI' may include false positives. AXELIOS and UG counts are too small to read. Counts depend on how the X is named in the Methods ('NovaSeq X Plus', 'NovaSeq 6000' not queried). The 6000 was not queried, so I cannot say how far the X has displaced it.
how_to_mine: Run the same queries with monthly FIRST_PDATE bins (Jan 2025–Sep 2026). Add 'NovaSeq 6000', 'NovaSeq X Plus', 'Element Biosciences', 'MGI DNBSEQ' or 'T7', and 'Revio'. Use cursorMark pagination on the AVITI hits to pull titles and affiliations and check for false positives. Break out the share by country and by funder (NIH vs other) using GRANT_AGENCY fields. Track the 6000-to-X Methods ratio as a conversion proxy in academic papers. Re-run in 2027 once lag has cleared.

items.label: 2B
items.claim: Open-access Methods mentions of rival sequencers (AVITI, Ultima UG, AXELIOS) are not gaining on NovaSeq X in academic papers.
items.detail: Europe PMC METHODS+OPEN_ACCESS hitCounts: rivals combined were 62 vs 656 NovaSeq X (9.5%) in H1'25, and 373 vs 4,230 (8.8%) for Jul'25–Sep'26. AVITI/AVITI24 alone was 54 vs 410 across periods, a stable ~8% of X. Publication lag means 2026 rival placements are not yet visible.
items.url: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=(METHODS:"AVITI24" OR METHODS:"AVITI") AND OPEN_ACCESS:y AND FIRST_PDATE:[2025-01-01 TO 2026-09-30]&format=json&pageSize=1&resultType=lite
items.why_new: First publication-based count series of rival vs X usage in academic Methods; not in the known list.

items.label: 2A
items.claim: Academic Methods mentions of NovaSeq X grew about 2.6x per month while rival mentions grew in step, so research use is still Illumina-dominated.
items.detail: NovaSeq X Methods mentions rose from ~109/month (H1'25) to ~282/month (Jul'25–Sep'26). AVITI rose from ~9 to ~24/month. AXELIOS/SBX total only 8 and UG-series 17, so the rival threat in research is still negligible in published work.

items.why_new: Quantifies academic usage lag; no prior publication-count series.
